summary: Every legal input has at most ten decimal positions, so the complete workload range is too narrow for an honest runtime scaling verdict over digit traversal.

workload_bound.source_constraint: n is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive

replacement_checks.evidence: The remotely accepted and app-local implementations divide the remaining value by ten after each iteration, so they process exactly D decimal positions and D is at most ten.

The certificate regression compares both stored source forms with an independent decimal-string oracle for every n from 1 through 1,000,000 and explicit threshold, repeated-digit, zero-digit, nine-digit, and 10^9 boundaries.
